subject: Important Update: Project Deadline Extension
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, we have decided to extend the deadline for the upcoming project. The new deadline is now set for next Friday, allowing us more time to ensure the quality of our work. Please adjust your timelines accordingly and reach out if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your understanding and continued hard work. Best regards, [Your Name]
